The Disenchanting Tables' base wage of Essence of Life: a same-id copy of RPG Stations' own Disenchant_Essence (both jar actions already list it, so no extension names it), carrying the jar's ladder unchanged (item level at weight 1, quality at weight 5, a better piece draws more; a jar retune of the ladder means copying it here again). What this copy adds is its Requires, the two Enchanting talents that give the wage up, read off the talent's own record (ziggfreedcommon:track_pick): Rite of Purity (a face of the Rite) trades it for Greater Essence of Life four times as likely, and Void Rite (a face of the Seeker's Rite) for a second roll of the Void finds on gear of item level 30 and up (25 and up at Seeker's Practice rank 1, 20 at rank 2). Each Not group shuts the wage only for a player and a piece it fully names, so everyone else, and a server with Enchanting switched off or no Enchanting track at all (where no group can pass), is paid as always. The trades that pay the wage AGAIN (Purist, Rite of Plenty, Essence Only) roll this same table from Mmo_Disenchant_Rites, so they follow the same gate.

Every number here is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: The base wage, the jar's own roll unchanged.
